The bank has explored finding partners to underwrite rejected applications for some of its co-branded credit cards, the report said.

The co-brand cards that millions of consumers use have long been the epicenter of a love-hate relationship between large merchants and banks. Banks take on much of the risk associated with whether those cardholders will default on their payments.
